root_cause.text: The bucket drop condition in mtype_del() incorrectly required n->pos to be zero, failing to recognize that a bucket can be logically empty (all live entries removed) when n->pos points past deleted slots, preventing memory from being freed.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes the condition from `if (n->pos == 0 && k == 0)` to `if (k == n->pos)`, and the commit message explicitly states that the original code misses buckets whose live entries have all been removed while n->pos still points past deleted slots.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix bucket empty check in mtype_del to free bucket when all entries are unused (k == n->pos) instead of requiring both n->pos and k to be zero.
intent_record.what: Changed condition for freeing a hash bucket from `if (n->pos == 0 && k == 0)` to `if (k == n->pos)`.
intent_record.how: After deleting an element, the code now correctly identifies an empty bucket when the number of unused entries (k) equals the total number of entries (n->pos), instead of requiring both values to be zero. This ensures the bucket is freed only when all entries are unused.
